page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.18xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 72 dedicated vCPUs utilizing Intel Xeon 8163 processors running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 288.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server configuration does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. There are no onboard GPUs, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or deep learning workloads. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 33 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers between instances and cloud services.

The ecs.g5ne.18xlarge offers a high-density, general-purpose resource profile. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio provides a balanced distribution of compute and memory resources, making it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that scale horizontally without requiring specialized hardware accelerators or local disk I/O. Appropriate workloads include enterprise web applications, medium-sized databases, container orchestration, and general-purpose business logic processing.
